title: AI agents just found 2 new cracks in RSA-1024
topic_summary: Google DeepMind (6 Nov 2026): human-guided AI agents found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA - signature forgery (~1,600x theoretical gain) and batch factoring (~30x cheaper per extra key). RSA-2048+ unaffected.

title: Cisco & OpenAI want to shield Linux before the patch lands
topic_summary: Cisco and OpenAI (23 Nov 2026) open-sourced Shirudo, an eBPF-based rewrite of Tetragon that deploys signed, AI-generated 'shields' (mitigations) into running Linux kernels and workloads without reboot or restart, to cover the gap before vendor patches. Pre-release; demoed on Java4Shell in a live Elasticsearch 9.5.5.

title: Google now asks your agent: did the user ask for this?
topic_summary: Google (23 Nov 2026) detailed Semantic governance policies, in Preview in Agent Gateway on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform: an LLM judge checks every proposed agent tool call against the user's intent and plain-language policies before it runs. On AgentDojo (gemini-2.5-flash) intent-hijacking attack success fell from 48.7% to 0.9% at ~2.6 points of benign utility.
